title: Akwi 400-NPC Library
objective: Publish exactly 400 owner-authorized Akwi NPC identities through the existing P-A2-NPC Universal Library path while preserving proposal/canon status, resolving only already-governed Species/homeworld/background references, excluding GM/private dossier content from the allow-all client corpus, and inventing no rules-profile mechanics or generated dependency objects.
authorization_basis: Owner explicitly authorized the NPC library and then instructed Continue after verified AKWI-02 completion.
preserved_boundaries: Import authorization does not convert proposed NPC content to source canon.
Exactly 400 source npc_id identities are in scope.
character_private_knowledge and gm_only_secret remain outside the A2 runtime until a role-aware projection exists.
No generated setting, faction, location, birthplace, or other dependency object is promoted merely because an NPC references it.
No invented HP, AC, speed, level, proficiency, initiative, resources, action math, or archetype math.
Species resolves to species.akwi and is not copied into NPC mechanics.
Background references remain candidate/proposed selections and do not mutate authoritative Character state.
next_action: Add failing AKWI-03 acceptance tests/profile first, verify the red failure is missing NPC runtime content, then generate and wire the bounded 400-NPC public-safe corpus, relationships and provenance.
